title: Show retry overlay before Chrome's iframe timeout error renders
description: On slow Sigma cold starts, Chrome's native 'app.sigmacomputing.com took too long to respond' page renders inside the iframe at ~30s. We can't detect or hide it cross-origin once it appears. Fix: track iframe onLoad event, and if it hasn't fired after a configurable timeout (e.g. 25s), show our own overlay over the iframe with a retry button. Retry should bump refreshKey to force a fresh JWT fetch and iframe reload.

title: Stale JWT reused when navigating back to Internal User embed
description: The first embed uses initialEmbedData passed from the server-rendered dashboard page. When the user navigates to the second embed and back, the SigmaEmbed component remounts and reuses the same server-rendered initialEmbedUrl, so the JWT never refreshes after the initial page load. Eventually that initial JWT expires, breaking the embed. Fix: only use initialEmbedData on the very first dashboard render; once the user navigates away, subsequent visits should fetch a fresh JWT client-side.

title: Build heavily-formatted page where embed blends into the host UI
description: Create a demo page in the dashboard where Sigma-embedded content is visually indistinguishable from the rest of the site — to show how embeds can be deeply integrated into a custom-designed product UI rather than looking like 'a Sigma iframe slapped into a page'. Approaches: custom-styled host page with cards, headers, and surrounding content; embed multiple smaller workbook elements rather than a full dashboard; use Sigma plugin visualizations (custom viz extensions) so the rendered content matches the host site's design language; apply themes / hide_menu / responsive_height to strip Sigma chrome. Use case: demonstrates to prospects what 'production-grade' embed integrations look like vs the simpler examples already on the site.

title: Demo cross-tenant content deployment alongside embed examples
description: Build a section in the embed site that demonstrates the production-embed-tenant + source-tenant relationship: embeds in the dashboard point at workbooks in the 'production' tenant (the one hosting the embedded content for end users), and an accompanying flow / explainer shows how that content was promoted from another tenant (dev/staging) into the production tenant. Likely needs: one or two embed pages pointing at the production-tenant workbooks, plus an explanation panel (or a flow diagram similar to the JWT auth flow) showing the deployment steps — e.g. source tenant → tagged version → promoted/deployed → production tenant → live in embed. Use case: helps prospects understand the realistic content lifecycle for an embed deployment, not just the runtime auth side.

title: Add demo page for embedded Sigma AI assistant
description: Build a new embed page showcasing Sigma's AI assistant inside the dashboard. The AI assistant lets end users ask natural-language questions against the embedded data. Investigate which Sigma URL params / JWT claims are required to surface the assistant in an embed (likely a control flag or a different embed URL pattern), add a new nav item in DashboardShell.js, and configure the env var for the workbook URL. Educational angle: show how this is part of the embed UX rather than a separate Sigma product, and that JWT/RLS still applies to whatever the assistant queries on behalf of the user.

title: Add demo page for eval_connection_id claim
description: Build a new embed page in the dashboard that showcases the Sigma eval_connection_id JWT claim, which lets the embed swap its underlying data source/connection based on the claim value. Demo flow: pick a connection target per user (likely via Clerk publicMetadata, e.g. evalConnectionId field), include it as eval_connection_id in the JWT payload from lib/sigma-embed.js, and surface it in the JWT inspector as a labeled claim with a description. Workbook on the Sigma side needs a published connection swap configured for this to work end-to-end. Use case: multi-tenant embed where different customers/orgs see the same workbook layout but pointed at their own data warehouse connection.
notes:
## Implementation plan

### On the Sigma side (prerequisites, not code)
- A workbook built against a source/template connection that supports connection swap
- Two or more target connection IDs to swap between (different databases / schemas / customer data sources)
- The workbook URL for the new embed page

### Code changes
- Add evalConnectionId field to Clerk publicMetadata schema (per user)
- Read it in the JWT API route from publicMetadata
- Pass it through generateSigmaEmbedUrl
- Add eval_connection_id claim to the signed JWT payload in lib/sigma-embed.js when present
- New nav item 'Workbook - Connection Swap' in DashboardShell.js
- New env var CONNECTION_SWAP_SIGMA_BASE_URL (local .env.local + Vercel)
- Add eval_connection_id to JwtInspector's claimMeta with description and a 'data source swap' badge (similar to RLS badge on user_attributes)
- Mention this claim in the Auth Flow diagram

### Suggested demo flow
- testembed@example.com → evalConnectionId: 'conn_xxx' (e.g. East-region warehouse)
- testembed2@example.com → evalConnectionId: 'conn_yyy' (e.g. West-region warehouse)
- Both load the same workbook page, see entirely different data
- JWT inspector shows eval_connection_id differing per user

### Open question
Whether to build the code side as a placeholder now (with workbook URL + connection IDs filled in later via env vars + Clerk metadata) or wait until the Sigma side is ready.

title: Add Clerk metadata field for per-user URL filter params on Secured embed
description: Currently Clerk publicMetadata.userAttributes goes into the JWT user_attributes claim (used by Sigma for RLS). We need a separate metadata field for params that get appended to the embed URL itself — e.g. workbook parameters or filter overrides — rather than going into the JWT. Scope per mode so only the relevant page applies them. Show the applied URL params in the JWT inspector for demo clarity.

title: Allow setting JWT session length from inspector for stale-token demos
description: Add a control in the JWT inspector that lets the user override the session length (exp claim) at runtime. Currently SESSION_LENGTH is fixed via env var. Need to: 1) accept sessionLength as a query param on /api/sigma/jwt and forward it to generateSigmaEmbedUrl, 2) allow generateSigmaEmbedUrl to accept a sessionLength override, 3) lift session length to DashboardShell state, pass down to SigmaEmbed which triggers a refetch when changed, 4) add input + preset buttons in JwtInspector (30s, 1m, 5m, default) and an 'Apply & regenerate' button.

title: Add a new embedded workbook page
description: Add a second navigation item to the dashboard for a new embedded Sigma workbook. Needs: nav label, env var (e.g. NEWPAGE_SIGMA_BASE_URL in .env.local + Vercel), nav item entry in components/DashboardShell.js with mode set to match the env var prefix, and an appropriate icon.

title: Rename 'Workbook Embed' nav item to 'Workbook - Internal User example'
description: Update the existing nav item label in components/DashboardShell.js so it reflects its purpose as an internal-user-style embed example. Both the NAV_ITEMS top-level label and the inner embeds[].label should be updated for consistency in breadcrumbs and the JWT inspector.
